citation: Anderwald C, Tura A, Grassi A, et al. Insulin Infusion During Normoglycemia Modulates Insulin Secretion According to Whole-Body Insulin Sensitivity. Diabetes Care. 2011.
protocol: Hyperinsulinaemic-isoglycaemic clamp, insulin 40 mU/min/m2 primed, 120 min (150 min in T2DM); glucose clamped to fasting level (4.44-5.55 mmol/L)
population: 65 insulin-sensitive (age 45+/-1, BMI 24.8), 17 insulin-resistant (46+/-2, BMI 28.1) and 20 T2DM (56+/-2, BMI 28.0) subjects
note: Basal and end-clamp values only (two points), by sensitivity class. Contains a T2DM arm.
